newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar mixed in low volume.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar mixed in low volume.

text.p: LIFFE sugar was mixed in featureless trade with minimal activity.
"There's nothing really to talk about," was one trader's description of the market.
He characterised the day's business as consolidation after falls Thursday.
By 1715 GMT active March was down $1.0 at $303.40. March had traded 432 lots out of a total by then of 935 lots.
March had seen a high of 304.50 earlier in the day. Traders characterised the market's moves as drift, in the absence of any factors which set a definite trend.
